caption: The drawing depicts a wooden beam oriented horizontally across the image, colored in various shades of brown to suggest texture and grain. Attached near the left end of the beam is a dark, hexagonal nut or bolt. Protruding diagonally upward and to the left from near the center is a hammer with a brown handle and metallic gray head. Below the beam and to the right of the hammer, there is a vertical metallic bracket secured to the wood by a bolt, and this bracket is connected to the beam with a thinner diagonal support rod. The entire composition is set against a plain, light beige or off-white background, without additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Carpet Stretcher
